> [!WARNING]
> **No longer maintained.** 1.x gets no updates and no weekly security rebuilds any more. Please switch to `:2`: in `compose.yaml`, change `ghcr.io/dropnook/dropnook:1` to `ghcr.io/dropnook/dropnook:2`, then *Compose Up*. Without users, Drop works exactly as before — your files, texts, links and PIN stay as they are. See [Dropnook 2.0](https://github.com/dropnook/dropnook.app/releases/tag/v2.0.0).

**Dropnook 1.2** — a lock for the door, and a place on your home screen.

* **PIN or password, if you want one.** Add `PIN: "…"` to `drop` in `compose.yaml`: every new device is asked for it once and then stays signed in for 90 days. Changing the PIN signs everyone out; after 10 wrong tries in 15 minutes a device has to wait. Without it, nothing changes.
* **Drop as an app.** iPhone: Safari → Share → *Add to Home Screen*. Android: *Install app*. Drop gets its own icon — also in the browser tab.
* **Share straight to Drop on Android.** Once installed, Drop is in the share menu: pictures and files land in the list, text and links in a new text field. Needs HTTPS. Other web sites cannot use this way to put anything into your Drop.

`compose.yaml` stays as it is; the PIN is optional (see the README, "PIN or password").
